name: Back To Tri-Cities 2024
information: **Luke Tycksen has been appointed as a Temporary Delegate for this competition.** This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. Please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/BackToTriCities2024#35664-competitor-responsibilities) tab. For more information about cubing in the Pacific Northwest, check out the [PNW website](https://www.pnwcubing.com)! We are doing an extra unnofficial event called Team Blindfolded at this competition! Go to the Team Blindfolded tab to learn more!
